incidents.name: UniLend V2 pool health-factor miscalculation
incidents.notes: The UnilendV2Pool health-factor check computed collateral value from a position whose lend side was being redeemed in the same call, so a flash-loaned lend/borrow/redeemUnderlying sequence let the attacker borrow the pool's entire stETH liquidity and then withdraw the collateral backing it.

sources.ref: onchain review: UnilendV2Pool (USDC/stETH) 0x4E34DD25Dbd367B1bF82E1B5527DBbE799fAD0d0 (verified, ContractName UnilendV2Pool) created 2024-02-12T18:14:11Z by 0x99a221a87b3c2238c90650fa9be0f11e4c499d06, not the attack-tx sender 0x55f5f8058816d5376df310770ca3a2e294089c33; no EIP-1967 events, 334.7 days old. Calls are routed through UnilendV2Core 0x7f2E24D2394f2bdabb464B888cb02EbA6d15B958 but the accounting the PoC abuses lives in the pool. Setup transactions 0xdaf42127499f878b62fc5ba2103135de1c36e1646487cee309c077296814f5ff and 0xefa9c4383dc58e492cd1c670d2661968db28fa7557b9c8f90685e5a6cbbf41fe precede the recorded drain. 60 stETH at a January 2025 ETH price near $3,300 is roughly $200k. Loss converted at the incident timestamp: 60 stETH x $3,251.10 (DefiLlama historical ETH price) = $195,066.

re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis. The victim is an EIP-1167 minimal proxy - runtime 0x363d3d373d3d3d363d73c86d2555f8c360d3c5e8e4364f42c1f2d169330e5af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf3 - so the delegate target 0xc86d2555f8c360d3c5e8e4364f42c1f2d169330e is baked into the bytecode and cannot be repointed. That master's runtime is byte-identical at 13 sample points across [19213660, 21608070] and contains zero DELEGATECALL opcodes; callTracer on the exploit tx confirms the clone delegatecalls only the master.
